title: Dwarf Name Generator
metaTitle: Dwarf Name Generator – Mighty Mountain & Clan Names for D&D / RPG
metaDescription: Generate rugged, thunderous Dwarven names for warriors, runepriests, and clan elders. Features authentic Old Norse and subterranean phonetics with clan titles.
heroSubtitle: Forge unyielding, guttural names hammered from volcanic stone, runic iron, and ancient mountain halls.

namingConventions.summary: Dwarven naming traditions are deeply tied to ancestral honor, metallurgy, and bedrock stone. A dwarf never speaks their true birth name lightly, reserving it for clan genealogies inscribed upon personal runic amulets.
namingConventions.phonetics: Dwarven phonetics favor plosives ('b', 'd', 'g', 'k', 't') and rolling velar sounds ('gr', 'br', 'dr', 'th'). Suffixes frequently echo heavy hammer falls on anvils, utilizing endings like '-in', '-or', '-mund', and '-grim'.
namingConventions.surnames: Clan names describe ancestral deeds, metallurgy, or geographic strongholds. Compound titles like Stonebreaker, Forgehammer, and Ironfoot serve as badges of clan fidelity and generational craft guilds.

faqs.question: How are female dwarf names different from male dwarf names?
faqs.answer: While female dwarf names retain the strong consonants of their mountain heritage, they often feature vocalic endings like '-a', '-dis', '-mira', '-run', or '-hild', reflecting maternal guardians of the hearth and ancient rune-weavers.

faqs.question: What is the role of a Dwarven Clan title?
faqs.answer: A clan surname is an inherited responsibility. If a dwarf brings shame to their hall, they may be stripped of their clan name and known merely by a wanderer's epithet until their honor is restored by trial or combat.

faqs.question: Are these names based on Tolkien or Norse mythology?
faqs.answer: Our algorithmic word banks synthesize both Old Norse edda roots (the historical source of modern fantasy dwarves) and tabletop RPG conventions from Dungeons & Dragons, Warhammer, and Pathfinder.

faqs.question: Can I save names across multiple sessions?
faqs.answer: Yes. When you click the star or bookmark icon on any name, it is automatically stored in your browser's persistent LocalStorage and accessible via the floating Favorites drawer.
